description: This file defines the LoggerAppenderMail class, which is a component of the log4php logging framework. It implements an appender that sends log events via email using PHP's mail() function, including properties for email configuration and methods for activating options, appending log events, and sending emails upon closing.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderMail
classes.description: A class that extends LoggerAppenderSkeleton to send log messages via email using PHP's mail() function.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderMail
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes the appender with a given name.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Activates optional configuration settings, setting the closed flag to false.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sends the accumulated log messages via email if conditions are met and marks the appender as closed.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Formats and appends a log event to the email body.
